shlokas.transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde karmayogo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ॐ तत् सत्। यस प्रकार श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता रूपी उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मविद्या र योगशास्त्रअन्तर्गत श्रीकृष्ण–अर्जुन संवादमा कर्मयोग नामक ३ अध्याय समाप्त भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Om tat sat. Thus ends chapter 3, named Karma Yoga, in the Upanishad of the Bhagavad Gita, the knowledge of Brahman, the scripture of yoga, in the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.

chapters.title_en: Jnana Karma Sannyasa Yoga — Knowledge and Renunciation of Action

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्। विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| imaṃ vivasvate yogaṃ proktavānahamavyayam| vivasvānmanave prāha manurikṣvākave'bravīt||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: यो अव्यय योग मैले विवस्वानलाई भनेँ; विवस्वानले मनुलाई, मनुले इक्ष्वाकुलाई भने।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: This imperishable yoga I declared to Vivasvat; Vivasvat told it to Manu, and Manu spoke it to Ikshvaku.

shlokas.sanskrit: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः। स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप॥
shlokas.transliteration: evaṃ paramparāprāptamimaṃ rājarṣayo viduḥ| sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ parantapa||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यसरी परम्पराबाट राजर्षिहरूले जाने; हे परन्तप, धेरै कालले यो योग यहाँ नष्ट भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Thus received in succession, the royal sages knew it. By long lapse of time, O scorcher of foes, this yoga was lost here.

shlokas.sanskrit: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः। भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sa evāyaṃ mayā te'dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ| bhakto'si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यही पुरातन योग आज मैले तिमीलाई भनेको छु; तिमी भक्त र सखा हौ — यो उत्तम रहस्य हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: That same ancient yoga is declared by me to you today; you are my devotee and my friend, and this is the highest secret.

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः। कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति॥
shlokas.transliteration: arjuna uvāca| aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ| kathametadvijānīyāṃ tvamādau proktavāniti||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्जुनले भने: तिम्रो जन्म पछि, विवस्वानको जन्म अघि; तिमीले आदिमा भनेको मैले कसरी बुझूँ?
shlokas.meaning_en: Arjuna said: Later is your birth, earlier the birth of Vivasvat. How am I to understand that you declared this in the beginning?

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन। तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna| tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha parantapa||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: हे अर्जुन, मेरा र तिम्रा धेरै जन्म बिते; म सबै जान्छु, तिमी जान्दैनौ, हे परन्तप।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: Many births of mine have passed, and of yours, Arjuna. I know them all; you do not, O scorcher of foes.

shlokas.sanskrit: अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्। प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय सम्भवाम्यात्ममायया॥
shlokas.transliteration: ajo'pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānāmīśvaro'pi san| prakṛtiṃ svāmadhiṣṭhāya sambhavāmyātmamāyayā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अज, अव्ययात्मा, भूतहरूको ईश्वर भएर पनि आफ्नै प्रकृतिमा अधिष्ठित भई आत्ममायाले म प्रकट हुन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Though unborn, of imperishable self, lord of beings, I come to be by presiding over my own prakriti, through my own maya.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata| abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे भारत, जब-जब धर्मको ग्लानि र अधर्मको अभ्युत्थान हुन्छ, तब म आफूलाई सृजन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whenever dharma declines, O Bharata, and adharma rises up, then I bring forth myself.

shlokas.sanskrit: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्। धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे॥
shlokas.transliteration: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām| dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge||
shlokas.meaning_ne: साधुहरूको परित्राण, दुष्कृतहरूको विनाश, धर्म संस्थापनका लागि युग-युगमा म जन्मन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: For the protection of the good, the destruction of the evil-doers, and the establishing of dharma, I come to be from age to age.

shlokas.sanskrit: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः। त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन॥
shlokas.transliteration: janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ| tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna||
shlokas.meaning_ne: मेरो दिव्य जन्म र कर्म तत्त्वतः जान्ने, हे अर्जुन, देह छाडेर पुनर्जन्म पाउँदैन, मकहाँ आउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who knows in truth my divine birth and work, Arjuna, having left the body is not born again; he comes to me.

shlokas.sanskrit: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः। बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ| bahavo jñānatapasā pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: राग-भय-क्रोधमुक्त, मन्मय, ममा आश्रित धेरै ज्ञानतपले पूत भई मद्भावमा आए।
shlokas.meaning_en: Freed from passion, fear, and anger, absorbed in me, taking refuge in me, many, purified by the tapas of knowledge, have come to my being.

shlokas.sanskrit: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्। मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः॥
shlokas.transliteration: ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham| mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसले जसरी मकहाँ आउँछन्, त्यसरी नै म भज्छु; हे पार्थ, सबै मानिस मेरो बाटो पछ्याउँछन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: As they approach me, so do I serve them. People follow my path in every way, O Partha.

shlokas.sanskrit: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः। क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा॥
shlokas.transliteration: kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ| kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्मको सिद्धि चाहनेहरू यहाँ देवता पूज्छन्; मानुष लोकमा कर्मज सिद्धि चाँडै हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Those who desire success of works worship the gods here; for in the human world, success born of works comes quickly.

shlokas.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः। तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: cāturvarṇyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ guṇakarmavibhāgaśaḥ| tasya kartāramapi māṃ viddhyakartāramavyayam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: गुण-कर्म विभागले चातुर्वर्ण्य मैले सृष्टि गरेको; त्यसको कर्ता भए पनि मलाई अकर्ता, अव्यय जान।
shlokas.meaning_en: The fourfold order was created by me according to the division of gunas and works. Though I am its maker, know me as the non-doer, unchanging.

shlokas.sanskrit: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा। इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā| iti māṃ yo'bhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्महरू मलाई लिप्त गर्दैनन्, कर्मफलमा मेरो स्पृहा छैन; यसरी जान्ने कर्मले बाँधिँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Actions do not stain me; I have no longing for the fruit of works. Who knows me thus is not bound by actions.

shlokas.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः। कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ| kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यसरी जानेर पहिलेका मुमुक्षुहरूले पनि कर्म गरे; तसर्थ पूर्वैले गरेको जस्तै तिमी पनि कर्म गर।
shlokas.meaning_en: Knowing this, action was done by the seekers of freedom of old as well. Therefore do action, as the ancients did of old.

shlokas.sanskrit: किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः। तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्॥
shlokas.transliteration: kiṃ karma kimakarmeti kavayo'pyatra mohitāḥ| tatte karma pravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्म के, अकर्म के — कविहरू पनि यहाँ मोहित छन्; जान्दा अशुभबाट मुक्त हुने कर्म म भन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: What is action, what is inaction? Even the seers are confused here. I shall tell you that action, knowing which you will be freed from ill.

shlokas.sanskrit: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः। अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः॥
shlokas.transliteration: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ| akarmaṇaśca boddhavyaṃ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्म पनि जान्नुपर्छ, विकर्म पनि, अकर्म पनि; कर्मको गति गहन छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: One must understand action, and understand wrong action, and understand inaction; the way of action is deep.

shlokas.sanskrit: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः। स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ| sa buddhimānmanuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kṛtsnakarmakṛt||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्ममा अकर्म देख्ने, अकर्ममा कर्म देख्ने मनुष्यहरूमा बुद्धिमान्, युक्त, कृत्स्न कर्म गर्ने हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who sees inaction in action and action in inaction is wise among men; he is yoked, a doer of all action.

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः। ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāmasaṅkalpavarjitāḥ| jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tamāhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसका सबै आरम्भ काम-सङ्कल्पवर्जित छन्, ज्ञानाग्निले कर्म दग्ध — बुधहरू उसलाई पण्डित भन्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: He whose every undertaking is free of desire-intent, whose works are burned in the fire of knowledge — him the wise call a pandita.

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः। कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः॥
shlokas.transliteration: tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ| karmaṇyabhipravṛtto'pi naiva kiñcitkaroti saḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्मफलासङ्ग त्यागेर नित्यतृप्त, निराश्रय; कर्ममा लागे पनि ऊ केही गर्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Having given up clinging to the fruit of works, always content, depending on nothing — though engaged in action, he does nothing at all.

shlokas.sanskrit: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः। शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ| śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: निराशी, यतचित्त, सर्वपरिग्रह त्यागी; केवल शारीर कर्म गर्दा किल्बिष लाग्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Without hope, mind and self restrained, having given up all grasping — doing only bodily action, he incurs no guilt.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः। समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ| samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यदृच्छालाभमा सन्तुष्ट, द्वन्द्वातीत, विमत्सर, सिद्धि-असिद्धिमा सम — गरे पनि बाँधिँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Content with what comes unsought, beyond the pairs, without envy, even in success and failure — though acting, he is not bound.

shlokas.sanskrit: गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः। यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते॥
shlokas.transliteration: gatasaṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthitacetasaḥ| yajñāyācarataḥ karma samagraṃ pravilīyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: गतसङ्ग, मुक्त, ज्ञानस्थित चित्तले यज्ञका लागि गरेको कर्म सबै विलीन हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Of one whose clinging is gone, who is free, whose mind is set in knowledge, action done for yajna dissolves entirely.

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्। ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना॥
shlokas.transliteration: brahmārpaṇaṃ brahma havirbrahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam| brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्पण ब्रह्म, हवि ब्रह्म, ब्रह्माग्निमा ब्रह्मद्वारा हुत; ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिले जाने ठाउँ ब्रह्म नै हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Brahman is the offering, Brahman the oblation, offered by Brahman in the fire of Brahman. Brahman is to be reached by him who is absorbed in the action that is Brahman.

shlokas.sanskrit: दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते। ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति॥
shlokas.transliteration: daivamevāpare yajñaṃ yoginaḥ paryupāsate| brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṃ yajñenaivopajuhvati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कति योगी देवयज्ञ उपासना गर्छन्; अरूले यज्ञैद्वारा ब्रह्माग्निमा यज्ञ होम गर्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Some yogins worship only the divine yajna; others offer the yajna itself by yajna into the fire of Brahman.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति। शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye saṃyamāgniṣu juhvati| śabdādīnviṣayānanya indriyāgniṣu juhvati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कति श्रोत्रादि इन्द्रिय संयमाग्निमा होम गर्छन्; अरू शब्द आदि विषय इन्द्रियाग्निमा होम गर्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Some offer the senses, hearing and the rest, into the fires of restraint; others offer the objects, sound and the rest, into the fires of the senses.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे। आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi prāṇakarmāṇi cāpare| ātmasaṃyamayogāgnau juhvati jñānadīpite||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अरू सबै इन्द्रियकर्म र प्राणकर्म ज्ञानदीप्त आत्मसंयमयोगाग्निमा होम गर्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Others offer all the actions of the senses and the actions of the breaths into the yoga-fire of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.

shlokas.sanskrit: द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे। स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: dravyayajñāstapoyajñā yogayajñāstathāpare| svādhyāyajñānayajñāśca yatayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कति द्रव्ययज्ञ, तपोयज्ञ, योगयज्ञ; संशितव्रत यतिहरू स्वाध्याय-ज्ञानयज्ञ पनि।
shlokas.meaning_en: Some are sacrifices of substance, of tapas, of yoga; and others, striving with sharp vows, are sacrifices of study and knowledge.

shlokas.sanskrit: अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे। प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः॥
shlokas.transliteration: apāne juhvati prāṇaṃ prāṇe'pānaṃ tathāpare| prāṇāpānagatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कति अपानमा प्राण, प्राणमा अपान होम गर्छन्; प्राणापान गति रोकेर प्राणायामपरायण हुन्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Others offer the out-breath into the in-breath, and the in-breath into the out-breath, stopping the courses of both, intent on pranayama.

shlokas.sanskrit: अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति। सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः॥
shlokas.transliteration: apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇānprāṇeṣu juhvati| sarve'pyete yajñavido yajñakṣapitakalmaṣāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अरू नियताहार प्राणलाई प्राणमा होम गर्छन्; यी सबै यज्ञवित्, यज्ञले कल्मष क्षीण।
shlokas.meaning_en: Others, of measured diet, offer the breaths into the breaths. All these know yajna, their stains worn away by yajna.

shlokas.sanskrit: यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्। नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम॥
shlokas.transliteration: yajñaśiṣṭāmṛtabhujo yānti brahma sanātanam| nāyaṃ loko'styayajñasya kuto'nyaḥ kurusattama||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यज्ञशेष अमृत खाने सनातन ब्रह्ममा जान्छन्; हे कुरुसत्तम, अयज्ञको यो लोक छैन, अर्को कहाँ?
shlokas.meaning_en: Those who eat the nectar-remainder of yajna go to the eternal Brahman. This world is not for one without yajna; how then the other, O best of Kurus?

shlokas.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे। कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे॥
shlokas.transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe| karmajānviddhi tānsarvānevaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यस्ता बहुविधा यज्ञ ब्रह्मको मुखमा फैलिएका छन्; सबै कर्मज जान; यसरी जाने मुक्त हुनेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Thus many kinds of yajna are spread out in the mouth of Brahman. Know them all as born of action; knowing thus you will be freed.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप। सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: śreyāndravyamayādyajñājjñānayajñaḥ parantapa| sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे परन्तप, द्रव्यमय यज्ञभन्दा ज्ञानयज्ञ श्रेष्ठ; हे पार्थ, सबै कर्म ज्ञानमा समाप्त हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Better than the yajna of substance is the yajna of knowledge, O scorcher of foes. All action without remainder is completed in knowledge, O Partha.

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया। उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: tadviddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā| upadekṣyanti te jñānaṃ jñāninastattvadarśinaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रणिपात, परिप्रश्न र सेवाले त्यो जान; तत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानीहरू तिमीलाई ज्ञान उपदेश गर्नेछन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Learn that by homage, by inquiry, and by service. Those who know, who have seen the truth, will teach you knowledge.

shlokas.sanskrit: यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव। येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि॥ (भूतान्यशेषाणि)
shlokas.transliteration: yajjñātvā na punarmohamevaṃ yāsyasi pāṇḍava| yena bhūtānyaśeṣeṇa drakṣyasyātmanyatho mayi|| (bhūtānyaśeṣāṇi)
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे पाण्डव, जान्दा फेरि यस्तो मोह हुँदैन; जसले सबै भूत आत्मामा र ममा देख्नेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Knowing which you will not fall into delusion again, O Pandava — by which you will see all beings without remainder in the Self, and then in me.

shlokas.sanskrit: अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः। सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि॥
shlokas.transliteration: api cedasi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ| sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyasi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सबै पापीहरूमा सबैभन्दा पापी भए पनि ज्ञानको नाउँले सबै वृजिन तर्नेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Even if you are the most evil-doing of all the evil-doers, you will cross all wickedness by the boat of knowledge alone.

shlokas.sanskrit: यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन। ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा॥
shlokas.transliteration: yathaidhāṃsi samiddho'gnirbhasmasātkurute'rjuna| jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसरी प्रज्वलित आगोले इन्धन भस्म पार्छ, हे अर्जुन, ज्ञानाग्निले सबै कर्म त्यस्तै भस्म पार्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: As a kindled fire makes fuel into ash, Arjuna, so the fire of knowledge makes all actions into ash.

shlokas.sanskrit: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते। तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
shlokas.transliteration: na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate| tatsvayaṃ yogasaṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ज्ञानसमान पवित्र यहाँ केही छैन; योगसंसिद्ध आफैं कालक्रममा आत्मामा पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Nothing here is so purifying as knowledge. One perfected in yoga finds it in due time in himself.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः। ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: śraddhāvām̐llabhate jñānaṃ tatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ| jñānaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śāntimacireṇādhigacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रद्धावान्, तत्पर, संयतेन्द्रिय ज्ञान पाउँछ; ज्ञान पाएर चाँडै परा शान्ति पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The faithful one, intent on that, with senses restrained, attains knowledge; having gained knowledge he soon reaches the highest peace.

shlokas.sanskrit: अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति। नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: ajñaścāśraddadhānaśca saṃśayātmā vinaśyati| nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अज्ञ, अश्रद्ध, संशयात्मा विनष्ट हुन्छ; संशयात्माको न यो लोक, न पर, न सुख।
shlokas.meaning_en: The ignorant, the unfaithful, and the doubting self are lost. For the doubting self there is neither this world nor the next, nor happiness.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसञ्छिन्नसंशयम्। आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय॥
shlokas.transliteration: yogasaṃnyastakarmāṇaṃ jñānasañchinnasaṃśayam| ātmavantaṃ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे धनञ्जय, योगले कर्म संन्यस्त, ज्ञानले संशय छिन्न, आत्मवान्लाई कर्म बाँध्दैनन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Actions do not bind one who has renounced works through yoga, whose doubt is cut by knowledge, who is possessed of the Self, O Dhananjaya.

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः। छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत॥
shlokas.transliteration: tasmādajñānasambhūtaṃ hṛtsthaṃ jñānāsinātmanaḥ| chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata||
shlokas.meaning_ne: तसर्थ अज्ञानजन्मे हृदयस्थित संशय ज्ञानको तरवारले काटेर योगमा रह, उठ, हे भारत।
shlokas.meaning_en: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge of the Self, cut this doubt born of ignorance that sits in the heart; be established in yoga, stand up, O Bharata.

shlokas.sanskrit: ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे ज्ञानकर्मसंन्यासयोगो नाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः॥ ४॥
shlokas.transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde jñānakarmasaṃnyāsayogo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ॐ तत् सत्। यस प्रकार श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता रूपी उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मविद्या र योगशास्त्रअन्तर्गत श्रीकृष्ण–अर्जुन संवादमा ज्ञानकर्मसंन्यासयोग नामक ४ अध्याय समाप्त भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Om tat sat. Thus ends chapter 4, named Jnana Karma Sannyasa Yoga, in the Upanishad of the Bhagavad Gita, the knowledge of Brahman, the scripture of yoga, in the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.

chapters.title_en: Karma Sannyasa Yoga — The Yoga of Renunciation

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि। यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: arjuna uvāca| saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi| yacchreya etayorekaṃ tanme brūhi suniścitam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्जुनले भने: हे कृष्ण, कर्मको संन्यास फेरि योग पनि प्रशंसा गर्छौ; यी दुईमध्ये श्रेय कुन हो, सुनिश्चित भन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Arjuna said: You praise the renunciation of actions, Krishna, and again yoga. Tell me for certain which one of these two is better.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ। तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśca niḥśreyasakarāvubhau| tayostu karmasaṃnyāsātkarmayogo viśiṣyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: संन्यास र कर्मयोग दुवै निःश्रेयसकर; तर कर्मसंन्यासभन्दा कर्मयोग श्रेष्ठ छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: Renunciation and karma-yoga both lead to the highest good; but of the two, karma-yoga is better than the renunciation of action.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति। निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati| nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhātpramucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: न द्वेष गर्ने न काङ्क्षा गर्नेलाई नित्य संन्यासी जान; निर्द्वन्द्व, हे महाबाहो, सुखपूर्वक बन्धनबाट मुक्त हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: He should be known as always a renouncer who neither hates nor longs. Free of the pairs, O mighty-armed, he is easily released from bondage.

shlokas.sanskrit: साङ्ख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः। एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sāṅkhyayogau pṛthagbālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ| ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyagubhayorvindate phalam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: साङ्ख्य र योगलाई बालकहरू छुट्टै भन्छन्, पण्डित होइनन्; एकमा राम्ररी स्थित दुवैको फल पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Fools say that Sankhya and yoga are different, not the wise. Established well in even one, a person wins the fruit of both.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्साङ्ख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते। एकं साङ्ख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति॥
shlokas.transliteration: yatsāṅkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tadyogairapi gamyate| ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: साङ्ख्यले जुन स्थान पाइन्छ, योगले पनि त्यहीं पुगिन्छ; साङ्ख्य र योग एक देख्नेले नै देख्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The place reached by the Sankhyas is reached by the yogins too. Who sees Sankhya and yoga as one, he sees.

shlokas.sanskrit: संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः। योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ| yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे महाबाहो, योगबिना संन्यास दुःखले पाइन्छ; योगयुक्त मुनि चाँडै ब्रह्म पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: But renunciation, O mighty-armed, is hard to attain without yoga. The sage yoked in yoga reaches Brahman before long.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः। सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ| sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvannapi na lipyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगयुक्त, विशुद्धात्मा, विजितात्मा, जितेन्द्रिय, सबै भूतमा आत्मा देख्ने — गर्दा पनि लिप्त हुँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Yoked in yoga, the self purified, the self conquered, the senses conquered, the self of all beings — though acting, he is not stained.

shlokas.sanskrit: नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्। पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन्॥
shlokas.transliteration: naiva kiñcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit| paśyañśṛṇvanspṛśañjighrannaśnangacchansvapañśvasan||
shlokas.meaning_ne: तत्त्ववित् युक्त «म केही गर्दिनँ» ठानोस् — देख्दै, सुन्दै, छुँदै, सुँघ्दै, खाँदै, हिँड्दै, सुत्दै, श्वास लिँदै।
shlokas.meaning_en: "I do nothing at all" — so should the yoked knower of truth think, seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, going, sleeping, breathing.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्॥
shlokas.transliteration: pralapanvisṛjangṛhṇannunmiṣannimiṣannapi| indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan||
shlokas.meaning_ne: बोल्दै, त्याग्दै, ग्रहण गर्दै, आँखा खोल्दै-चिम्लँदै पनि — इन्द्रियहरू इन्द्रियार्थमा वर्तन्छन् भनी धारण गर्दै।
shlokas.meaning_en: Speaking, letting go, grasping, opening and closing the eyes — holding that the senses move among the sense-objects.

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः। लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा॥
shlokas.transliteration: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ| lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ब्रह्ममा कर्म राखी सङ्ग त्यागेर गर्ने पापले लिप्त हुँदैन — जलले कमलपत्र जस्तै।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who acts, placing actions in Brahman, abandoning clinging, is not stained by sin, as a lotus leaf by water.

shlokas.sanskrit: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि। योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये॥
shlokas.transliteration: kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi| yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmaśuddhaye||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगीहरू काय, मन, बुद्धि, केवल इन्द्रियले पनि सङ्ग त्यागेर आत्मशुद्धिका लागि कर्म गर्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Yogins perform action with body, mind, insight, even with the senses alone, abandoning clinging, for the purification of the self.

shlokas.sanskrit: युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्। अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm| ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: युक्तले कर्मफल त्यागेर नैष्ठिकी शान्ति पाउँछ; अयुक्त कामले फलमा सक्त भई बाँधिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The yoked one, abandoning the fruit of works, attains peace that is firm. The unyoked, acting from desire, attached to the fruit, is bound.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी। नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī| navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan||
shlokas.meaning_ne: मनले सबै कर्म संन्यस्त गरी वशी नवद्वार पुरमा सुखले बस्छ — न गर्ने, न गराउने।
shlokas.meaning_en: Having mentally renounced all actions, the embodied one, self-controlled, sits happily in the city of nine gates, neither acting nor causing action.

shlokas.sanskrit: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः। न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते॥
shlokas.transliteration: na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ| na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvastu pravartate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रभुले लोकको कर्तृत्व, कर्म, कर्मफलसंयोग सृष्टि गर्दैन; स्वभाव वर्तन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Lord does not create agency or actions for the world, nor the joining to the fruit of works; it is own-nature that operates.

shlokas.sanskrit: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः। अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः॥
shlokas.transliteration: nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ| ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विभु कसैको पाप लिँदैन, सुकृत पनि होइन; अज्ञानले ज्ञान ढाकिएकाले जन्तु मोहित हुन्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The all-pervading takes on no one's evil, nor even good deed. Knowledge is covered by ignorance; by that, creatures are deluded.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः। तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ| teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको त्यो अज्ञान ज्ञानले नाश भएको छ, तिनको ज्ञान सूर्यजस्तै तत्परलाई प्रकाशित गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: But for those whose ignorance of the Self is destroyed by knowledge, that knowledge lights up the highest, like the sun.

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः। गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः॥
shlokas.transliteration: tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ| gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यसमा बुद्धि, त्यसमा आत्मा, त्यसमा निष्ठा, त्यसमा परायण; ज्ञानले कल्मष धोइएका अपुनरावृत्ति जान्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Their insight on That, their self That, their faith That, their goal That — their stains shaken off by knowledge, they go to non-return.

shlokas.sanskrit: विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि। शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: vidyāvinayasampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini| śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विद्या-विनयसम्पन्न ब्राह्मण, गाई, हात्ती, कुकुर र श्वपाकमा पण्डितहरू समदर्शी हुन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: In a brahmana endowed with learning and humility, in a cow, an elephant, a dog, and a dog-cooker, the wise see the same.

shlokas.sanskrit: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः। निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ| nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको मन साम्यमा स्थित, तिनले यहीं सर्ग जितेका छन्; ब्रह्म निर्दोष सम छ, तसर्थ तिन ब्रह्ममा स्थित छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Even here creation is conquered by those whose mind is established in sameness. Brahman is flawless and even; therefore they are established in Brahman.

shlokas.sanskrit: न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्। स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः॥
shlokas.transliteration: na prahṛṣyetpriyaṃ prāpya nodvijetprāpya cāpriyam| sthirabuddhirasammūḍho brahmavid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रिय पाएर हर्ष नमान्ने, अप्रिय पाएर उद्विग्न नहुने, स्थिरबुद्धि, असम्मूढ ब्रह्मवित् ब्रह्ममा स्थित छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: He should not rejoice on gaining the pleasant, nor be shaken on gaining the unpleasant — stable in insight, undeluded, a knower of Brahman, established in Brahman.

shlokas.sanskrit: बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्। स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते॥
shlokas.transliteration: bāhyasparśeṣvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yatsukham| sa brahmayogayuktātmā sukhamakṣayamaśnute||
shlokas.meaning_ne: बाह्य स्पर्शमा असक्त आत्माले आत्मामा जे सुख छ त्यो पाउँछ; ब्रह्मयोगयुक्त अक्षय सुख भोग्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Unattached in outer contacts, he finds the joy that is in the Self. With self yoked in the yoga of Brahman, he enjoys joy that does not wane.

shlokas.sanskrit: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते। आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः॥
shlokas.transliteration: ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te| ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कौन्तेय, संस्पर्शज भोग दुःखका योनि हुन्, आदि-अन्तवाल; बुध तिनमा रम्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: The enjoyments that are born of contact are wombs of pain, O son of Kunti, with beginning and end. The wise one does not delight in them.

shlokas.sanskrit: शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्। कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः॥
shlokas.transliteration: śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prākśarīravimokṣaṇāt| kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शरीर छाड्नुअघि नै काम-क्रोधको वेग सहने युक्त, सुखी नर हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who is able, even here, before release from the body, to bear the surge born of desire and anger — he is yoked, he is a happy man.

shlokas.sanskrit: योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः। स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: yo'ntaḥsukho'ntarārāmastathāntarjyotireva yaḥ| sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto'dhigacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अन्तःसुख, अन्तराराम, अन्तर्ज्योति योगी ब्रह्मभूत भई ब्रह्मनिर्वाण पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who has joy within, delight within, and light within — that yogin, become Brahman, attains brahma-nirvana.

shlokas.sanskrit: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः। छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: labhante brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ| chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: क्षीणकल्मष, छिन्नद्वैध, यतात्मा, सर्वभूतहितरत ऋषिहरू ब्रह्मनिर्वाण पाउँछन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The seers whose stains are spent, whose dualities are cut, who are self-restrained, intent on the good of all beings, attain brahma-nirvana.

shlokas.sanskrit: कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्। अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: kāmakrodhaviyuktānāṃ yatīnāṃ yatacetasām| abhito brahmanirvāṇaṃ vartate viditātmanām||
shlokas.meaning_ne: काम-क्रोधमुक्त, यतचेतस्, विदितात्मा यतिहरूका चारैतिर ब्रह्मनिर्वाण वर्तन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: For striving ones free of desire and anger, with minds restrained, who know the Self, brahma-nirvana lies close on every side.

shlokas.sanskrit: स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः। प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ॥
shlokas.transliteration: sparśānkṛtvā bahirbāhyāṃścakṣuścaivāntare bhruvoḥ| prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā nāsābhyantaracāriṇau||
shlokas.meaning_ne: बाह्य स्पर्श बाहिर राखी, दृष्टि भृकुटीबीच, नासाभित्र चल्ने प्राणापानलाई सम पारी।
shlokas.meaning_en: Shutting out outer contacts, the gaze set between the brows, making even the in-breath and out-breath that move within the nostrils.

shlokas.sanskrit: यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः। विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ| vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: इन्द्रिय-मन-बुद्धि वशमा, मोक्षपरायण मुनि, इच्छा-भय-क्रोधमुक्त — ऊ सधैं मुक्त नै हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: With senses, mind, and insight restrained, the sage intent on release, gone desire, fear, and anger — he who is thus is forever free.

shlokas.sanskrit: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्। सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram| suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यज्ञ-तपको भोक्ता, सर्वलोक महेश्वर, सबै भूतको सुहृद् मलाई जानेर शान्ति पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Knowing me as the enjoyer of yajnas and tapas, the great lord of all worlds, the friend of all beings, he reaches peace.

shlokas.sanskrit: ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे संन्यासयोगो नाम पञ्चमोऽध्यायः॥ ५॥
shlokas.transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde saṃnyāsayogo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ॐ तत् सत्। यस प्रकार श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता रूपी उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मविद्या र योगशास्त्रअन्तर्गत श्रीकृष्ण–अर्जुन संवादमा संन्यासयोग नामक ५ अध्याय समाप्त भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Om tat sat. Thus ends chapter 5, named Karma Sannyasa Yoga, in the Upanishad of the Bhagavad Gita, the knowledge of Brahman, the scripture of yoga, in the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.

chapters.title_en: Dhyana Yoga — The Yoga of Meditation

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः। स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ| sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: कर्मफलमा अनाश्रित कर्तव्य कर्म गर्ने संन्यासी र योगी हो; अग्निरहित वा अक्रिय होइन।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: He who does the action that must be done, not depending on the fruit of works, is a renouncer and a yogin — not he who lights no fire and does no acts.

shlokas.sanskrit: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव। न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन॥
shlokas.transliteration: yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava| na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे पाण्डव, संन्यास भनेको त्यही योग जान; संकल्प नत्यागी कोही योगी हुँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: What they call renunciation, know that to be yoga, O Pandava. No one becomes a yogin who has not renounced the intent of desire.

shlokas.sanskrit: आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते। योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate| yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योग चढ्न चाहने मुनिका लागि कर्म कारण भनिन्छ; योगारूढका लागि शम कारण भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: For the sage who would climb to yoga, action is said to be the means; for that same one who has climbed to yoga, stillness is said to be the means.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते। सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate| sarvasaṅkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जब इन्द्रियार्थ र कर्ममा नअल्झिन्छ, सबै संकल्प संन्यस्त — त्यस बेला योगारूढ भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: When he is attached neither to sense-objects nor to actions, having renounced all intents of desire — then he is said to have climbed to yoga.

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet| ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: आत्माले आफूलाई उबारोस्, नगिराओस्; आत्मा नै आत्माको बन्धु, आत्मा नै रिपु।
shlokas.meaning_en: One should lift the self by the self, and not let the self sink. The self is the self's friend, and the self is the self's enemy.

shlokas.sanskrit: बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः। अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ| anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसले आत्माले आत्मालाई जितेको छ, त्यसको आत्मा बन्धु हो; नजितेकोलाई आत्मा शत्रुजस्तै वर्तन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The self is a friend to that self by whom the self is conquered; but to the unconquered self, the self would behave with enmity, like an enemy.

shlokas.sanskrit: जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः। शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः॥
shlokas.transliteration: jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ| śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जितात्मा, प्रशान्तको परमात्मा समाहित छ — शीत-उष्ण, सुख-दुःख, मान-अपमानमा।
shlokas.meaning_en: Of one who has conquered the self and is at peace, the highest Self is gathered — in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, honour and dishonour.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः। युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ| yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ज्ञान-विज्ञानतृप्त, कूटस्थ, विजितेन्द्रिय, माटो-ढुङ्गा-सुनमा सम योगी युक्त भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The self content with knowledge and realization, unmoved, senses conquered — that yogin is called yoked, to whom a clod, a stone, and gold are the same.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु। साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu| sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सुहृद्, मित्र, अरि, उदासीन, मध्यस्थ, द्वेष्य, बन्धु, साधु र पापीमा समबुद्धि श्रेष्ठ हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: He is distinguished whose insight is even toward well-wishers, friends, foes, the indifferent, mediators, the hateful, kinsmen, the good, and even the wicked.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः। एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ| ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगी एकाकी रहस्यमा स्थित, यतचित्त, निराशी, अपरिग्रह भई सधैं आत्मालाई युक्त राखोस्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The yogin should continually join the self, staying in secret, alone, mind and self restrained, without hope, without grasping.

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः। नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ| nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शुचि देशमा आफ्नो आसन स्थिर राख्नु — अति उच्च वा अति नीच होइन, वस्त्र-अजिन-कुश ओछ्याई।
shlokas.meaning_en: In a clean place he should set his firm seat, neither too high nor too low, with cloth, hide, and kusha above.

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः। उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये॥
shlokas.transliteration: tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ| upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye||
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यहाँ एकाग्र मन, यतचित्त-इन्द्रियक्रिया भई आसनमा बसी आत्मविशुद्धिका लागि योग युक्त राख्नु।
shlokas.meaning_en: There, making the mind one-pointed, restraining the activities of thought and senses, seated on the seat, he should practise yoga for the purification of the self.

shlokas.sanskrit: समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः। सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्॥
shlokas.transliteration: samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ| samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan||
shlokas.meaning_ne: काय-शिर-ग्रीवा सम, अचल, स्थिर राखी आफ्नो नासिकाग्र हेर्दै दिशा नहेरी।
shlokas.meaning_en: Holding body, head, and neck even, unmoving, steady, gazing at the tip of his own nose, not looking around at the quarters.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः। मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः॥
shlokas.transliteration: praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ| manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रशान्तात्मा, भयमुक्त, ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतमा स्थित, मन संयम गरी मच्चित्त, मत्पर भई युक्त बस्नु।
shlokas.meaning_en: The self at peace, gone fear, established in the vow of brahmacharya, restraining the mind, thought on me, he should sit yoked, intent on me.

shlokas.sanskrit: युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः। शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ| śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यसरी सधैं आत्मा युक्त राख्ने नियतमानस् योगी निर्वाणपरा शान्ति, मत्संस्था पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Joining the self thus always, the yogin of restrained mind attains the peace whose highest is nirvana, the state that is in me.

shlokas.sanskrit: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः। न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन॥
shlokas.transliteration: nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ| na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अति खानेको योग हुँदैन, बिल्कुलै नखानेको पनि होइन; अति सुत्ने वा जाग्नेको पनि होइन, हे अर्जुन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Yoga is not for one who eats too much, nor for one who does not eat at all; nor for one who sleeps too much, nor for one who stays awake, Arjuna.

shlokas.sanskrit: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु। युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा॥
shlokas.transliteration: yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu| yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: युक्त आहार-विहार, कर्ममा युक्त चेष्टा, युक्त निद्रा-जागरणको योग दुःखहन्ता हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: For one moderate in food and sport, moderate in effort at works, moderate in sleep and waking, yoga becomes the destroyer of pain.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते। निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate| niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जब विनियत चित्त आत्मामा नै अवस्थित हुन्छ, सबै कामबाट निःस्पृह — त्यस बेला युक्त भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: When the well-restrained thought stands in the Self alone, without longing for any desires — then one is said to be yoked.

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता। योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā| yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: निवातमा दीप नहल्लिएजस्तै, यतचित्त योगी आत्माको योग गर्दाको उपमा हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: As a lamp in a windless place does not flicker — that simile is remembered of the yogin of restrained thought, practising the yoga of the Self.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया। यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति॥
shlokas.transliteration: yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā| yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगसेवाले निरुद्ध चित्त जहाँ उपराम हुन्छ, जहाँ आत्माले आत्मा देखेर आत्मामा तृप्त हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Where thought, restrained by the practice of yoga, comes to rest, and where, seeing the Self by the Self, one is content in the Self.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्। वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः॥
shlokas.transliteration: sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam| vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: बुद्धिले ग्राह्य अतीन्द्रिय आत्यन्तिक सुख जहाँ जान्छ, र स्थित भई तत्त्वबाट चलित हुँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Where one knows that joy which is ultimate, to be grasped by insight, beyond the senses — and, established, does not stir from the real.

shlokas.sanskrit: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः। यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ| yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसलाई पाएर त्यसभन्दा बढी लाभ मान्दैन; जहाँ स्थित भई गुरु दुःखले पनि विचलित हुँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Having gained which, one thinks no other gain greater than that; established in which, one is not shaken even by heavy sorrow.

shlokas.sanskrit: तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्। स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा॥
shlokas.transliteration: taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam| sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: दुःखसंयोगको वियोगलाई योगसंज्ञित जान्नु; अनिर्विण्ण चित्तले निश्चयपूर्वक त्यो योग युक्त राख्नु।
shlokas.meaning_en: That disjunction from contact with pain should be known as named yoga. That yoga is to be practised with determination, with a mind that does not sink.

shlokas.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः। मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः॥
shlokas.transliteration: saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ| manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: संकल्पबाट जन्मिएका सबै काम अशेष त्यागेर मनले नै इन्द्रियग्राम सबैतिर विनियम गर्नु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Abandoning without remainder all desires born of intention, restraining the host of senses on every side by the mind alone.

shlokas.sanskrit: शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया। आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā| ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet||
shlokas.meaning_ne: धृतिले समातिएको बुद्धिले बिस्तारै उपराम होओस्; मन आत्मसंस्थ पारी केही पनि नसोचोस्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Little by little one should come to rest by insight held with firmness; making the mind abide in the Self, one should think of nothing whatsoever.

shlokas.sanskrit: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram| tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet||
shlokas.meaning_ne: चञ्चल अस्थिर मन जहाँ-जहाँ निस्किन्छ, त्यहाँ-त्यहाँ यसलाई नियन्त्रण गरी आत्माको वशमा ल्याउनु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Wherever the flickering, unsteady mind runs out, from there one should restrain it and bring it into the power of the Self alone.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्। उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam| upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रशान्तमनस्, शान्तरजस्, ब्रह्मभूत, अकल्मष योगीकहाँ उत्तम सुख आउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: For this yogin of peaceful mind, highest joy comes — his rajas stilled, become Brahman, without stain.

shlokas.sanskrit: युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः। सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ| sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यसरी सधैं आत्मा युक्त, विगतकल्मष योगी सुखपूर्वक ब्रह्मसंस्पर्श, अत्यन्त सुख भोग्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Joining the self thus always, the yogin whose stain is gone easily enjoys the touch of Brahman, joy without limit.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani| īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शी सबै भूतमा आत्मा र आत्मामा सबै भूत देख्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The self yoked in yoga, seeing the same everywhere, sees the Self standing in all beings and all beings in the Self.

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति। तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति॥
shlokas.transliteration: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati| tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जो मलाई सर्वत्र देख्छ, सबैलाई ममा देख्छ — त्यसबाट म हराउँदिनँ, ऊ मबाट हराउँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who sees me everywhere and sees all in me — I am not lost to him, nor is he lost to me.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ| sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सर्वभूतस्थित मलाई एकत्वमा स्थित भई भज्ने योगी जसरी वर्ते पनि ममा वर्तन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who worships me as standing in all beings, established in oneness — that yogin, however he moves, moves in me.

shlokas.sanskrit: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन। सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः॥
shlokas.transliteration: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna| sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे अर्जुन, आत्मौपम्यले सर्वत्र सुख वा दुःख सम देख्ने परम योगी मानिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who sees the same everywhere by comparison with the self, whether in pleasure or in pain — that yogin is held the highest, Arjuna.

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन। एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: arjuna uvāca| yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana| etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्जुनले भने: हे मधुसूदन, साम्यले भनेको यो योग चञ्चलताले स्थिर स्थिति म देख्दिनँ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Arjuna said: This yoga you have declared through evenness, O Madhusudana — I do not see its steady standing, because of restlessness.

shlokas.sanskrit: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम्। तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham| tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कृष्ण, मन चञ्चल, प्रमाथी, बलवान्, दृढ छ; यसको निग्रह वायु जत्तिकै सुदुष्कर ठान्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: For the mind is restless, Krishna, turbulent, strong, and stubborn. I think its restraint as hard as that of the wind.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्। अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam| abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: हे महाबाहो, मन दुर्निग्रह, चल छ, असंदेह; तर हे कौन्तेय, अभ्यास र वैराग्यले गृह्य हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is hard to restrain, restless. But by practice and by dispassion it is held, O son of Kunti.

shlokas.sanskrit: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः। वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः॥
shlokas.transliteration: asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ| vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: असंयतात्माको योग दुष्प्राप मेरो मत हो; वश्यात्मा प्रयत्न गर्ने उपायले पाउन सकिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Yoga is hard to reach, I hold, for one whose self is unrestrained. But by one whose self is under control, who strives, it can be reached by the means.

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः। अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: arjuna uvāca| ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ| aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्जुनले भने: श्रद्धायुक्त तर अयति, योगबाट चित्त चलित, योगसंसिद्धि नपाई, हे कृष्ण, कुन गति जान्छ?
shlokas.meaning_en: Arjuna said: One who is endowed with faith but unrestrained, whose mind has strayed from yoga, not reaching yoga's perfection — what way does he go, Krishna?

shlokas.sanskrit: कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति। अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि॥
shlokas.transliteration: kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati| apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे महाबाहो, के ऊ दुवैबाट भ्रष्ट, छिन्न बादलजस्तै नष्ट हुन्छ — अप्रतिष्ठ, ब्रह्मपथमा विमूढ?
shlokas.meaning_en: Does he not perish, fallen from both, like a riven cloud, O mighty-armed — without standing, confused on the path of Brahman?

shlokas.sanskrit: एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः। त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ| tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कृष्ण, मेरो यो संशय अशेष काट्न योग्य छौ; तिमीबाहेक यस संशयको छेत्ता हुँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: This doubt of mine you should cut away completely, Krishna. Other than you, a cutter of this doubt is not to be found.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते। न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate| na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: हे पार्थ, त्यसको न यहाँ न अमुत्र विनाश छ; हे तात, कल्याणकृत् कोही दुर्गति जाँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: O Partha, neither here nor hereafter is there destruction for him. No one who does what is auspicious, dear one, goes to a bad end.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः। शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते॥
shlokas.transliteration: prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ| śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: पुण्यकृत्का लोक पाएर शाश्वत वर्ष बसी, योगभ्रष्ट शुचि श्रीमान्हरूको घरमा जन्मन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Having reached the worlds of those who did good, dwelling there for lasting years, the fallen-from-yoga is born in the house of the pure and prosperous.

shlokas.sanskrit: अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्। एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām| etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अथवा धीमान् योगीहरूकै कुलमा जन्मन्छ; यस्तो जन्म लोकमा दुर्लभतर हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Or he comes to be in a family of yogins themselves, who are wise. Such a birth as this is more hard to find in the world.

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्। यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन॥
shlokas.transliteration: tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam| yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana||
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यहाँ पौर्वदेहिक बुद्धिसंयोग पाउँछ; हे कुरुनन्दन, त्यसपछि फेरि संसिद्धिका लागि यत्न गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: There he gains the joining of insight from his former body, and he strives again from there toward perfection, O joy of the Kurus.

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः। जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते॥
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ| jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यसै पूर्वाभ्यासले अवश भए पनि तानिन्छ; योगको जिज्ञासु पनि शब्दब्रह्म नाघ्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: By that former practice he is carried, even unwilling. Even a seeker of yoga passes beyond the brahman of word.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः। अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ| anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रयत्नपूर्वक यत्न गर्ने संशुद्धकिल्विष योगी अनेक जन्ममा संसिद्ध भई परा गति जान्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: But the yogin who strives with effort, his guilt well washed, perfected through many births, then goes to the highest course.

shlokas.sanskrit: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः। कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन॥
shlokas.transliteration: tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ| karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna||
shlokas.meaning_ne: तपस्वीभन्दा योगी अधिक, ज्ञानीभन्दा पनि अधिक, कर्मीभन्दा अधिक; तसर्थ हे अर्जुन, योगी होओ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The yogin is beyond the tapasvins, held beyond the knowers too, and beyond those of works. Therefore be a yogin, Arjuna.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना। श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā| śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सबै योगीमध्ये अन्तःआत्मा ममा गएको, श्रद्धावान् भई मलाई भज्नेलाई म युक्ततम मान्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: And of all yogins, who worships me with faith, the inner self gone to me — he is held by me the most yoked.

shlokas.sanskrit: ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे आत्मसंयमयोगो नाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः॥ ६॥
shlokas.transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde ātmasaṃyamayogo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ॐ तत् सत्। यस प्रकार श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता रूपी उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मविद्या र योगशास्त्रअन्तर्गत श्रीकृष्ण–अर्जुन संवादमा आत्मसंयमयोग नामक ६ अध्याय समाप्त भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Om tat sat. Thus ends chapter 6, named Dhyana Yoga, in the Upanishad of the Bhagavad Gita, the knowledge of Brahman, the scripture of yoga, in the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.

chapters.title_en: Jnana Vijnana Yoga — Knowledge and Realization

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः। असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ| asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: हे पार्थ, ममा आसक्त मन, मदाश्रय भई योग गर्दै, सन्देहरहित समग्र मलाई जसरी जान्नेछौ त्यो सुन।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: Hear, O Partha, how, with mind attached to me, practising yoga, taking refuge in me, you shall know me wholly, without doubt.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ| yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विज्ञानसहित यो ज्ञान म तिमीलाई अशेष भन्छु; जान्दा यहाँ फेरि जान्न बाँकी केही रहँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: I shall tell you this knowledge together with its realization, without remainder. Knowing it, nothing further remains here to be known.

shlokas.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये। यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः॥
shlokas.transliteration: manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye| yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हजारौं मनुष्यमध्ये कोही सिद्धिका लागि यत्न गर्छ; यत्न गर्ने सिद्धहरूमा पनि कोही मलाई तत्त्वतः जान्दछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Among thousands of men, one strives for perfection; among those who strive and even among the perfected, one knows me in truth.

shlokas.sanskrit: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च। अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा॥
shlokas.transliteration: bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca| ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: भूमि, जल, अनल, वायु, आकाश, मन, बुद्धि र अहङ्कार — यो मेरो आठ भागमा भिन्ना प्रकृति हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, insight, and I-making — this is my prakriti, divided eightfold.

shlokas.sanskrit: अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्। जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām| jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यो अपरा हो; यसभन्दा अर्को मेरी परा प्रकृति जान, हे महाबाहो — जीवभूता, जसले यो जगत् धारण गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: This is the lower. Know my other prakriti as higher than this, O mighty-armed — the living being by which this world is upheld.

shlokas.sanskrit: एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय। अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा॥
shlokas.transliteration: etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya| ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सबै भूत यिनै दुईको योनि हुन् भनी धारण गर; म नै कृत्स्न जगत्को प्रभव र प्रलय हुँ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Hold that all beings have their womb in these two. I am the arising of the whole world, and its dissolution as well.

shlokas.sanskrit: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय। मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव॥
shlokas.transliteration: mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya| mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे धनञ्जय, मभन्दा परतर केही छैन; यो सब ममा प्रोत छ — सूत्रमा मणिहरू जस्तै।
shlokas.meaning_en: There is nothing else higher than me, O Dhananjaya. All this is strung on me as gems on a thread.

shlokas.sanskrit: रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः। प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु॥
shlokas.transliteration: raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ| praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कौन्तेय, जलमा रस म हुँ, शशि-सूर्यको प्रभा म, सबै वेदमा प्रणव, आकाशमा शब्द, मनुष्यमा पौरुष।
shlokas.meaning_en: I am the taste in water, O son of Kunti, the radiance of moon and sun, the pranava in all the Vedas, sound in space, and manhood in men.

shlokas.sanskrit: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ। जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु॥
shlokas.transliteration: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau| jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu||
shlokas.meaning_ne: पृथ्वीमा पुण्य गन्ध म, अग्निमा तेज म, सबै भूतमा जीवन म, तपस्वीहरूमा तप म।
shlokas.meaning_en: I am the pure fragrance in the earth and the heat in fire. I am the life in all beings, and tapas in those who practise tapas.

shlokas.sanskrit: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्। बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam| buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे पार्थ, सबै भूतको सनातन बीज मलाई जान; बुद्धिमान्हरूको बुद्धि म, तेजस्वीहरूको तेज म।
shlokas.meaning_en: Know me as the eternal seed of all beings, O Partha. I am the insight of the insightful, the brilliance of the brilliant.

shlokas.sanskrit: बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्। धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ॥
shlokas.transliteration: balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam| dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha||
shlokas.meaning_ne: काम-रागरहित बलवान्हरूको बल म हुँ; हे भरतर्षभ, भूतहरूमा धर्मविरुद्ध नभएको काम म हुँ।
shlokas.meaning_en: I am the strength of the strong, free of desire and clinging. In beings I am desire that does not run against dharma, O best of Bharatas.

shlokas.sanskrit: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये। मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि॥
shlokas.transliteration: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye| matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सात्त्विक, राजस, तामस जति भाव छन्, ती मबाटै हुन् जान; तर म तिनमा छैन, ती ममा छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whatever states are of sattva, of rajas, or of tamas, know them as from me alone. I am not in them; they are in me.

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्। मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat| mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यी तीन गुणमय भावले मोहित यो सब जगत्, यिनभन्दा पर अव्यय मलाई चिन्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Deluded by these three states made of the gunas, this whole world does not know me, who am beyond them, unchanging.

shlokas.sanskrit: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया। मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते॥
shlokas.transliteration: daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā| māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te||
shlokas.meaning_ne: गुणमयी यो दैवी मेरी माया दुरत्यय छ; मकहाँ नै शरण पर्नेहरू यो माया तर्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: This divine maya of mine, made of the gunas, is hard to cross. Those who take refuge in me alone cross this maya.

shlokas.sanskrit: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः। माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ| māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: दुष्कृती, मूढ, नराधमहरू मकहाँ आउँदैनन् — मायाले ज्ञान हरेका, आसुर भावमा आश्रित।
shlokas.meaning_en: The evil-doers, the deluded, the lowest of men do not take refuge in me — their knowledge stolen by maya, they rest in an asuric nature.

shlokas.sanskrit: चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन। आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ॥
shlokas.transliteration: caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna| ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे अर्जुन, चारथरी सुकृती जन मलाई भज्छन् — आर्त, जिज्ञासु, अर्थार्थी र ज्ञानी, हे भरतर्षभ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Four kinds of people who have done good worship me, Arjuna: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of gain, and the knower, O best of Bharatas.

shlokas.sanskrit: तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते। प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः॥
shlokas.transliteration: teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate| priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: तिनमध्ये नित्ययुक्त एकभक्त ज्ञानी श्रेष्ठ हो; ज्ञानीलाई म अत्यन्त प्रिय, ऊ पनि मलाई प्रिय।
shlokas.meaning_en: Of these the knower, always yoked, of single devotion, is distinguished. I am exceedingly dear to the knower, and he is dear to me.

shlokas.sanskrit: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्। आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam| āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यी सबै उदार हुन्; तर ज्ञानीलाई म आत्मा नै ठान्छु। ऊ युक्तात्मा ममा नै स्थित, अनुत्तम गति म नै।
shlokas.meaning_en: All these are generous; but the knower I hold as my very self. He, the yoked self, is established in me, the unsurpassed goal.

shlokas.sanskrit: बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते। वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः॥
shlokas.transliteration: bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate| vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: धेरै जन्मको अन्त्यमा ज्ञानवान् मकहाँ आउँछ — «वासुदेव नै सब» भनी; त्यो महात्मा सुदुर्लभ हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: At the end of many births the one who knows takes refuge in me, thinking "Vasudeva is all." Such a great-souled one is very hard to find.

shlokas.sanskrit: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः। तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया॥
shlokas.transliteration: kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ| taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ति-ति कामले ज्ञान हरेका अरू देवताकहाँ जान्छन्; आफ्नै प्रकृतिले नियत भई त्यही-त्यही नियम अपनाउँछन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Those whose knowledge is carried off by this or that desire take refuge in other gods, following this or that rule, constrained by their own prakriti.

shlokas.sanskrit: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति। तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati| tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham||
shlokas.meaning_ne: भक्त जुन-जुन रूप श्रद्धाले पूज्ने इच्छा गर्छ, त्यसैको अचला श्रद्धा म नै दिन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whatever form a devotee wishes to worship with faith, that very faith I make unshaken for him.

shlokas.sanskrit: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते। लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate| labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitānhi tān||
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यस श्रद्धाले युक्त भई त्यसको आराधना गर्छ; त्यहाँबाट काम पाउँछ — ती मैले नै विहित।
shlokas.meaning_en: Yoked with that faith he strives in that worship, and from it he obtains his desires — those indeed appointed by me.

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्। देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि॥
shlokas.transliteration: antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām| devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अल्पमेधाहरूको त्यो फल अन्तवत् हुन्छ; देवपूजक देवताकहाँ जान्छन्, मद्भक्त मकहाँ जान्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: But that fruit of theirs is finite, for those of small understanding. Worshippers of the gods go to the gods; my devotees go to me as well.

shlokas.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः। परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ| paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अबुद्धिहरू मलाई अव्यक्त व्यक्तिमा आएको ठान्छन्; मेरो अव्यय अनुत्तम पर भाव जान्दैनन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The unwise think I have come from the unmanifest into manifestation, not knowing my higher being, unchanging and unsurpassed.

shlokas.sanskrit: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः। मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ| mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगमायाले ढाकिएको म सबैलाई प्रकाश हुँदिनँ; यो मूढ लोक अज अव्यय मलाई चिन्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: I am not revealed to all, wrapped in yoga-maya. This deluded world does not know me, unborn, unchanging.

shlokas.sanskrit: वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन। भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन॥
shlokas.transliteration: vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna| bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे अर्जुन, बितेका, वर्तमान र हुने सबै भूत म जान्छु; तर मलाई कोही जान्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: I know the beings that are past, that are present, and that are yet to be, Arjuna; but no one knows me.

shlokas.sanskrit: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत। सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप॥
shlokas.transliteration: icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata| sarvabhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे भारत, इच्छा-द्वेषबाट उठेको द्वन्द्वमोहले, हे परन्तप, सर्गमा सबै भूत सम्मोहमा जान्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: By the delusion of the pairs, sprung from wanting and aversion, all beings go to bewilderment at birth, O Bharata, scorcher of foes.

shlokas.sanskrit: येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām| te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: पुण्यकर्मी जनहरूको पाप अन्त्य भएपछि द्वन्द्वमोहबाट मुक्त भई दृढव्रतले मलाई भज्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: But those whose evil has come to an end, people of good works, freed from the delusion of the pairs, worship me with firm vows.

shlokas.sanskrit: जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये। ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye| te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जरा-मरण मोक्षका लागि ममा आश्रित यत्न गर्नेहरू त्यो ब्रह्म, कृत्स्न अध्यात्म र सबै कर्म जान्दछन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Those who strive, taking refuge in me, for release from old age and death, know that Brahman, the whole of the inner self, and all action.

shlokas.sanskrit: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः। प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः॥
shlokas.transliteration: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ| prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अधिभूत, अधिदैव र अधियज्ञसहित मलाई जान्ने युक्तचित्तहरू प्रयाणकालमा पनि मलाई जान्दछन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Those who know me together with what pertains to beings, to the gods, and to yajna, know me even at the hour of going forth, their minds yoked.

shlokas.sanskrit: ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगो नाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः॥ ७॥
shlokas.transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde jñānavijñānayogo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ॐ तत् सत्। यस प्रकार श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता रूपी उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मविद्या र योगशास्त्रअन्तर्गत श्रीकृष्ण–अर्जुन संवादमा ज्ञानविज्ञानयोग नामक ७ अध्याय समाप्त भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Om tat sat. Thus ends chapter 7, named Jnana Vijnana Yoga, in the Upanishad of the Bhagavad Gita, the knowledge of Brahman, the scripture of yoga, in the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.

chapters.title_en: Aksara Brahma Yoga — The Imperishable Brahman

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम। अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: arjuna uvāca| kiṃ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama| adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्जुनले भने: हे पुरुषोत्तम, त्यो ब्रह्म के, अध्यात्म के, कर्म के? अधिभूत के भनिएको, अधिदैव के भनिन्छ?
shlokas.meaning_en: Arjuna said: What is that Brahman, what the inner self, what action, O highest Person? What is called that which pertains to beings, and what is said to be that which pertains to the gods?

shlokas.sanskrit: अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन। प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः॥
shlokas.transliteration: adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana| prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे मधुसूदन, यस देहमा अधियज्ञ कसरी, को हो? नियतात्माहरूले प्रयाणकालमा तिमीलाई कसरी जानिन्छ?
shlokas.meaning_en: How and who is the lord of yajna here in this body, O Madhusudana? And how are you to be known at the hour of going forth by those of restrained self?

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते। भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः॥
shlokas.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca| akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate| bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रीभगवान्ले भने: परम अक्षर ब्रह्म हो; स्वभावलाई अध्यात्म भनिन्छ; भूतभावको उद्भव गराउने विसर्ग कर्मसंज्ञित हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Blessed Lord said: Brahman is the highest Imperishable; own-nature is called the inner self. The issuing that causes the arising of the being of beings is named action.

shlokas.sanskrit: अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्। अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर॥
shlokas.transliteration: adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam| adhiyajño'hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara||
shlokas.meaning_ne: क्षयशील भाव अधिभूत हो, पुरुष अधिदैवत; हे देहभृत् श्रेष्ठ, यस देहमा अधियज्ञ म नै हुँ।
shlokas.meaning_en: That which pertains to beings is the perishable state; the Person is that which pertains to the gods. I myself am the lord of yajna here in the body, O best of the embodied.

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्। यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
shlokas.transliteration: antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram| yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अन्तकालमा मलाई नै सम्झेर कलेवर छाडी जाने मद्भावमा जान्छ; यहाँ सन्देह छैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who at the last hour, remembering me alone, goes forth leaving the body, goes to my being. Of this there is no doubt.

shlokas.sanskrit: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्। तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram| taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कौन्तेय, अन्त्यमा जुन-जुन भाव सम्झेर कलेवर छाड्छ, त्यही-त्यहीमा जान्छ — सधैं त्यस भावले भावित भएकाले।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whatever state one remembers as he leaves the body at the end, that very state he reaches, O son of Kunti, always formed by that state.

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च। मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः॥ (संशयम्)
shlokas.transliteration: tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca| mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayaḥ|| (saṃśayam)
shlokas.meaning_ne: तसर्थ सबै कालमा मलाई अनुस्मरण गर र युद्ध गर; मन-बुद्धि ममा अर्पण गरेर सन्देहरहित मकहाँ आउनेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Therefore at all times remember me and fight. With mind and insight offered to me you will come to me without doubt.

shlokas.sanskrit: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना। परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्॥
shlokas.transliteration: abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā| paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अभ्यासयोगले युक्त, अन्यत्र नजाने चित्तले दिव्य परम पुरुषलाई अनुचिन्तन गर्दै हे पार्थ, जान्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: With thought yoked by the yoga of practice, going nowhere else, he goes to the divine highest Person, O Partha, meditating on him.

shlokas.sanskrit: कविं पुराणमनुशासितार- मणोरणीयंसमनुस्मरेद्यः। सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप- मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्॥
shlokas.transliteration: kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāra- maṇoraṇīyaṃsamanusmaredyaḥ| sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpa- mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कवि, पुराण, अनुशास्ता, अणुभन्दा अणु, सबैको धाता, अचिन्त्यरूप, आदित्यवर्ण, तमभन्दा पर — जसले अनुस्मरण गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who remembers the Seer, the Ancient, the Ordainer, smaller than the small, the supporter of all, of unthinkable form, sun-coloured, beyond darkness.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव। भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: prayāṇakāle manasā'calena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva| bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रयाणकालमा अचल मन, भक्ति र योगबलले युक्त, भ्रुकुटिबीच प्राण राम्ररी राखी त्यो दिव्य परम पुरुषलाई पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: At the hour of going forth, with unmoving mind, yoked with bhakti and the strength of yoga, setting the breath well between the brows, he reaches that divine highest Person.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः। यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति तत्ते पदं सङ्ग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ| yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye||
shlokas.meaning_ne: वेदवित्हरूले अक्षर भन्ने, वीतराग यतिहरू प्रवेश गर्ने, चाहेर ब्रह्मचर्य गर्ने — त्यो पद म संक्षेपमा भन्छु।
