shlokas.transliteration: duḥkhamityeva yatkarma kāyakleśabhayāttyajet| sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कर्म दुःख हो भनी कायक्लेशको भयले त्याग्ने राजस त्याग गरेर त्यागफल पाउँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who abandons action as pain, from fear of bodily distress, doing a rajasic relinquishing, does not gain the fruit of relinquishing.

shlokas.sanskrit: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन। सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः॥
shlokas.transliteration: kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ kriyate'rjuna| saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे अर्जुन, नियत कर्म «कार्य» भनी सङ्ग र फल त्यागेर गरिन्छ भने त्यो त्याग सात्त्विक मानिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: When prescribed action is done, Arjuna, simply as what ought to be done, abandoning clinging and fruit, that relinquishing is held sattvic.

shlokas.sanskrit: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते। त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः॥
shlokas.transliteration: na dveṣṭyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate| tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अकुशल कर्म द्वेष गर्दैन, कुशलमा अनुषङ्ग गर्दैन; सत्त्वसमाविष्ट मेधावी छिन्नसंशय त्यागी।
shlokas.meaning_en: He does not hate unskilled action, nor cling to the skilled. The relinquisher, filled with sattva, is insightful, his doubt cut.

shlokas.sanskrit: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः। यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते॥
shlokas.transliteration: na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ| yastu karmaphalatyāgī sa tyāgītyabhidhīyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: देहभृत्ले कर्म अशेष त्याग्न सकिँदैन; कर्मफलत्यागीलाई त्यागी अभिधान गरिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: For it is not possible for one who bears a body to abandon actions without remainder. Who abandons the fruit of action is designated a relinquisher.

shlokas.sanskrit: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्। भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्॥
shlokas.transliteration: aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam| bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अनिष्ट, इष्ट, मिश्र — कर्मको त्रिविध फल अत्यागीलाई प्रेत्य हुन्छ; संन्यासीलाई कहिल्यै होइन।
shlokas.meaning_en: The threefold fruit of action — unwished, wished, and mixed — comes after death to those who do not relinquish, but nowhere to those who have renounced.

shlokas.sanskrit: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे। साङ्ख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: pañcaitāni mahābāho kāraṇāni nibodha me| sāṅkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarvakarmaṇām||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे महाबाहो, सबै कर्मको सिद्धिका लागि साङ्ख्य कृतान्तमा प्रोक्त यी पाँच कारण मसँग जान।
shlokas.meaning_en: Learn from me these five causes, O mighty-armed, declared in the Sankhya that ends action, for the accomplishment of all works.

shlokas.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्। विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham| vividhāśca pṛthakceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अधिष्ठान, कर्ता, पृथग्विध करण, विविध पृथक् चेष्टा, र यहाँ पाँचौं दैव।
shlokas.meaning_en: The basis, and the doer, and the various kinds of instrument, and the several movements of many kinds, and fate here as the fifth.

shlokas.sanskrit: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः। न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः॥
shlokas.transliteration: śarīravāṅmanobhiryatkarma prārabhate naraḥ| nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शरीर-वाक्-मनले नर जुन कर्म आरम्भ गर्छ — न्याय्य वा विपरीत — यी पाँच त्यसका हेतु हुन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whatever action a man undertakes with body, speech, and mind, right or the reverse, these five are its causes.

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः। पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः॥
shlokas.transliteration: tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ| paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvānna sa paśyati durmatiḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यस्तो हुँदा केवल आत्मालाई कर्ता देख्ने, अकृतबुद्धि भएकाले, दुर्मति देख्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: That being so, who sees the self alone as the doer, from unmade insight — that ill-minded one does not see.

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य नाहङ्कृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते। हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: yasya nāhaṅkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate| hatvā'pi sa imām̐llokānna hanti na nibadhyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको अहङ्कृत भाव छैन, बुद्धि लिप्त हुँदैन — यी लोक मारे पनि मार्दैन, बाँधिँदैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whose being is not I-made, whose insight is not stained — though he slay these worlds, he does not slay, and is not bound.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना। करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसङ्ग्रहः॥
shlokas.transliteration: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā| karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṅgrahaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ज्ञान, ज्ञेय, परिज्ञाता — त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना; करण, कर्म, कर्ता — त्रिविध कर्मसङ्ग्रह।
shlokas.meaning_en: Knowledge, the knowable, and the knower are the threefold goad of action. Instrument, action, and doer are the threefold gathering of action.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः। प्रोच्यते गुणसङ्ख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि॥
shlokas.transliteration: jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ| procyate guṇasaṅkhyāne yathāvacchṛṇu tānyapi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ज्ञान, कर्म र कर्ता गुणभेदले त्रिधै प्रोच्य हुन्छ गुणसङ्ख्यानमा; यथावत् पृथक् सुन, ती पनि।
shlokas.meaning_en: Knowledge, action, and doer are declared as threefold by the difference of gunas in the counting of the gunas. Hear them also as they are, separately.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते। अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvamavyayamīkṣate| avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सबै भूतमा एक अव्यय भाव, विभक्तमा अविभक्त हेर्ने ज्ञान सात्त्विक जान।
shlokas.meaning_en: That knowledge by which one sees in all beings a single unchanging being, undivided in the divided — know that knowledge as sattvic.

shlokas.sanskrit: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्। वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān| vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: पृथक्त्वले नानाभाव पृथग्विध सबै भूतमा जान्ने ज्ञान राजस जान।
shlokas.meaning_en: But that knowledge which, by separateness, knows in all beings various beings of various kinds — know that knowledge as rajasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्। अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam| atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: एक कार्यमा कृत्स्नवत् सक्त, अहैतुक, अतत्त्वार्थवत्, अल्प — त्यो तामस उदाहृत।
shlokas.meaning_en: But that which is attached to a single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, not reaching the real, and slight — that is declared tamasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्। अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam| aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: नियत, सङ्गरहित, अरागद्वेष, अफलप्रेप्सुले कृत कर्म सात्त्विक भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Prescribed action, done without clinging, without attraction or aversion, by one who does not seek fruit — that is called sattvic.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः। क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ| kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कामेप्सु वा साहङ्कार, बहुलायासले गरिने कर्म राजस उदाहृत।
shlokas.meaning_en: But action that is done by one seeking desire, or again with I-making, with much labour — that is declared rajasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्। मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanapekṣya ca pauruṣam| mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अनुबन्ध, क्षय, हिंसा, पौरुष नहेरी मोहले आरम्भ गरिने कर्म तामस भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Action undertaken from delusion, without regard to consequence, loss, harm, or one's own power — that is called tamasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: muktasaṅgo'nahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ| siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: मुक्तसङ्ग, अनहंवादी, धृति-उत्साहसमन्वित, सिद्धि-असिद्धिमा निर्विकार कर्ता सात्त्विक भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Free of clinging, not saying "I", endowed with firmness and energy, unchanged in success and failure — the doer is called sattvic.

shlokas.sanskrit: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः। हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः॥
shlokas.transliteration: rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako'śuciḥ| harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: रागी, कर्मफलप्रेप्सु, लुब्ध, हिंसात्मक, अशुचि, हर्ष-शोकान्वित कर्ता राजस परिकीर्तित।
shlokas.meaning_en: Passionate, seeking the fruit of works, greedy, harmful by nature, impure, joined to elation and grief — the doer is declared rajasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः। विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko'lasaḥ| viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अयुक्त, प्राकृत, स्तब्ध, शठ, नैष्कृतिक, अलस, विषादी, दीर्घसूत्री कर्ता तामस भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Unyoked, vulgar, stiff, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent, and dilatory — the doer is called tamasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु। प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय॥
shlokas.transliteration: buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu| procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे धनञ्जय, बुद्धि र धृतिको गुणतः त्रिविध भेद अशेष पृथक्त्वले प्रोच्यमान सुन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Hear the threefold distinction of insight and of firmness according to the gunas, being told without remainder, separately, O Dhananjaya.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये। बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी॥
shlokas.transliteration: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye| bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī||
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रवृत्ति-निवृत्ति, कार्य-अकार्य, भय-अभय, बन्ध-मोक्ष जान्ने बुद्धि, हे पार्थ, सात्त्विकी।
shlokas.meaning_en: The insight that knows going-forth and turning-back, what is to be done and not done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and release — that insight, O Partha, is sattvic.

shlokas.sanskrit: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च। अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी॥
shlokas.transliteration: yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca| ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसले धर्म-अधर्म, कार्य-अकार्य अयथावत् जान्दछ, हे पार्थ, त्यो बुद्धि राजसी।
shlokas.meaning_en: The insight by which one knows dharma and adharma, and what is to be done and not done, not as they are — that insight, O Partha, is rajasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता। सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी॥
shlokas.transliteration: adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā| sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī||
shlokas.meaning_ne: तमले आवृत अधर्मलाई धर्म ठान्ने, सब अर्थ विपरीत, हे पार्थ, त्यो बुद्धि तामसी।
shlokas.meaning_en: The insight which, wrapped in tamas, thinks adharma to be dharma, and all things reversed — that insight, O Partha, is tamasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः। योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी॥
shlokas.transliteration: dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ| yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī||
shlokas.meaning_ne: योगले अव्यभिचारिणी धृतिले मन-प्राण-इन्द्रिय क्रिया धारण गर्ने, हे पार्थ, सात्त्विकी धृति।
shlokas.meaning_en: The firmness by which one holds the activities of mind, breaths, and senses, unswerving, through yoga — that firmness, O Partha, is sattvic.

shlokas.sanskrit: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन। प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी॥
shlokas.transliteration: yayā tu dharmakāmārthāndhṛtyā dhārayate'rjuna| prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे अर्जुन, धर्म-काम-अर्थ धृतिले धारण गर्ने, प्रसङ्गले फलाकाङ्क्षी, हे पार्थ, राजसी धृति।
shlokas.meaning_en: But the firmness by which one holds dharma, desire, and gain, O Arjuna, wanting fruit from attachment — that firmness, O Partha, is rajasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च। न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी॥
shlokas.transliteration: yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca| na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī||
shlokas.meaning_ne: स्वप्न, भय, शोक, विषाद, मद नछाड्ने दुर्मेधा, हे पार्थ, तामसी धृति।
shlokas.meaning_en: The firmness by which a dull-minded one does not give up sleep, fear, grief, despondency, and intoxication — that firmness, O Partha, is tamasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ। अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha| abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे भरतर्षभ, अब त्रिविध सुख सुन — जहाँ अभ्यासले रम्छ र दुःखको अन्त जान्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: And now hear from me the threefold joy, O best of Bharatas, in which one delights by practice and goes to the end of pain.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्। तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme'mṛtopamam| tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अग्रमा विषजस्तो, परिणाममा अमृतोपम; आत्मबुद्धिप्रसादज त्यो सुख सात्त्विक प्रोक्त।
shlokas.meaning_en: That which is like poison at first, like deathless nectar in its ripening — that joy is declared sattvic, born of the clarity of self-insight.

shlokas.sanskrit: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्। परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre'mṛtopamam| pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विषय-इन्द्रिय संयोगबाट अग्रमा अमृतोपम, परिणाममा विषजस्तो — त्यो सुख राजस स्मृत।
shlokas.meaning_en: That which from the joining of senses and objects is like deathless nectar at first, like poison in its ripening — that joy is remembered as rajasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः। निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ| nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अग्रमा र अनुबन्धमा आत्मा मोहन गर्ने सुख; निद्रा-आलस्य-प्रमादबाट उठेको तामस उदाहृत।
shlokas.meaning_en: The joy that, at first and in its following, deludes the self, arising from sleep, sloth, and heedlessness, is declared tamasic.

shlokas.sanskrit: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः। सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः॥
shlokas.transliteration: na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ| sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: पृथ्वीमा वा दिवि देवताहरूमा पनि यी तीन प्रकृतिज गुणबाट मुक्त सत्त्व छैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: There is no being on earth, or again among the gods in heaven, that could be free of these three gunas born of prakriti.

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप। कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः॥
shlokas.transliteration: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa| karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे परन्तप, ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, विश् र शूद्रका कर्म स्वभावप्रभव गुणले प्रविभक्त छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The actions of brahmanas, kshatriyas, vaishyas, and shudras, O scorcher of foes, are apportioned by the gunas that arise from their own-nature.

shlokas.sanskrit: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च। ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca| jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शम, दम, तप, शौच, क्षान्ति, आर्जव, ज्ञान, विज्ञान, आस्तिक्य — ब्राह्मणकर्म स्वभावज।
shlokas.meaning_en: Stillness, restraint, tapas, purity, forbearance, straightforwardness, knowledge, realization, and trust — the work of a brahmana, born of own-nature.

shlokas.sanskrit: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्। दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam| dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शौर्य, तेज, धृति, दाक्ष्य, युद्धमा अपलायन, दान, ईश्वरभाव — क्षात्र कर्म स्वभावज।
shlokas.meaning_en: Valour, brilliance, firmness, skill, and not fleeing in battle, giving, and lordliness — the work of a kshatriya, born of own-nature.

shlokas.sanskrit: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्। परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam| paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कृषि, गौरक्ष्य, वाणिज्य वैश्यकर्म स्वभावज; परिचर्यात्मक कर्म शूद्रको पनि स्वभावज।
shlokas.meaning_en: Farming, cow-keeping, and trade are the work of a vaishya, born of own-nature. Work whose nature is service is also born of the shudra's own-nature.

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः। स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु॥
shlokas.transliteration: sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ| svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu||
shlokas.meaning_ne: आ-आफ्नो कर्ममा अभिरत नर संसिद्धि पाउँछ; स्वकर्मनिरत कसरी सिद्धि पाउँछ त्यो सुन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Devoted to his own action, a man gains complete perfection. Hear how one devoted to his own action finds perfection.

shlokas.sanskrit: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः॥
shlokas.transliteration: yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam| svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसबाट भूतहरूको प्रवृत्ति, जसले यो सब तत छ — स्वकर्मले त्यसलाई अभ्यर्च्य मानव सिद्धि पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: From whom is the going-forth of beings, by whom all this is spread — worshipping him with his own action, a human being finds perfection.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt| svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विगुण स्वधर्म सुष्ठु परधर्मभन्दा श्रेयस्कर; स्वभावनियत कर्म गर्दा किल्बिष लाग्दैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Better one's own dharma, though imperfect, than another's well performed. Doing action determined by own-nature, one does not incur guilt.

shlokas.sanskrit: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्। सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः॥
shlokas.transliteration: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet| sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कौन्तेय, सहज कर्म सदोष भए पनि नत्याग्नु; सबै आरम्भ दोषले आवृत छन् — धुवाँले आगो जस्तै।
shlokas.meaning_en: The action born with one, O son of Kunti, even if faulty, one should not abandon. All undertakings are wrapped in fault, as fire by smoke.

shlokas.sanskrit: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः। नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति॥
shlokas.transliteration: asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ| naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सर्वत्र असक्तबुद्धि, जितात्मा, विगतस्पृह संन्यासले परम नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धि अधिगमन गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Insight unattached everywhere, the self conquered, longing gone — by renunciation he attains the highest perfection of freedom from works.

shlokas.sanskrit: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे। समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा॥
shlokas.transliteration: siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me| samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सिद्धि पाएर ब्रह्म कसरी पाउँछ जान, हे कौन्तेय, संक्षेपमा — ज्ञानको परा निष्ठा जुन हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: How one who has reached perfection attains Brahman, learn from me, O son of Kunti, in brief — that which is the highest standing of knowledge.

shlokas.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च। शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च॥
shlokas.transliteration: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca| śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विशुद्ध बुद्धिले युक्त, धृतिले आत्मा नियम गरी, शब्दादि विषय त्यागी, राग-द्वेष व्युदस्त।
shlokas.meaning_en: Yoked with a purified insight, restraining the self with firmness, abandoning objects, sound and the rest, and putting off attraction and aversion.

shlokas.sanskrit: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः। ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः॥
shlokas.transliteration: viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ| dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: विविक्तसेवी, लघ्वाशी, यतवाक्-काय-मानस, नित्य ध्यानयोगपर, वैराग्य उपाश्रित।
shlokas.meaning_en: Dwelling in solitude, eating lightly, speech, body, and mind restrained, always intent on the yoga of meditation, taking refuge in dispassion.

shlokas.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्। विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
shlokas.transliteration: ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham| vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अहङ्कार, बल, दर्प, काम, क्रोध, परिग्रह विमुच्य, निर्मम, शान्त — ब्रह्मभूयका लागि कल्पित।
shlokas.meaning_en: Released from I-making, strength, arrogance, desire, anger, grasping, without 'mine', at peace — he is fit for becoming Brahman.

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati| samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ब्रह्मभूत प्रसन्नात्मा नशोक गर्छ नकाङ्क्षा; सबै भूतमा सम भई परा मद्भक्ति पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Become Brahman, the self clear, he neither grieves nor longs. Even toward all beings, he attains the highest bhakti to me.

shlokas.sanskrit: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः। ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ| tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram||
shlokas.meaning_ne: भक्तिले मलाई तत्त्वतः जान्दछ — जति र जस्तो छु; तत्त्वतः जानेर त्यसपछि ममा विशत हुन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: By bhakti he knows me in truth, how great I am and who. Then, knowing me in truth, he enters immediately after.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः। मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ| matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सधैं सबै कर्म गर्दै पनि मद्व्यपाश्रय मत्प्रसादले शाश्वत अव्यय पद पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Even performing all actions always, taking refuge in me, by my grace he attains the everlasting, unchanging place.

shlokas.sanskrit: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः। बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव॥
shlokas.transliteration: cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ| buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava||
shlokas.meaning_ne: चित्तले सबै कर्म ममा संन्यस्त, मत्पर, बुद्धियोग उपाश्रित, सतत मच्चित्त होओ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Mentally renouncing all actions in me, intent on me, taking refuge in the yoga of insight, be one whose thought is on me always.

shlokas.sanskrit: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि। अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि॥
shlokas.transliteration: maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi| atha cettvamahaṅkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: मच्चित्त मत्प्रसादले सबै दुर्गा तर्नेछौ; यदि अहङ्कारले नसुन्नेछौ भने विनष्ट हुनेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: With thought on me you will cross all hard passes by my grace. But if from I-making you will not hear, you will perish.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे। मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति॥
shlokas.transliteration: yadahaṅkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase| mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अहङ्कार आश्रित «युद्ध गर्दिनँ» ठान्छौ भने त्यो व्यवसाय मिथ्या; प्रकृति तिमीलाई नियुक्त गर्नेछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: If, resorting to I-making, you think "I will not fight," this resolve of yours is false; prakriti will set you to it.

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा। कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्॥
shlokas.transliteration: svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā| kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśo'pi tat||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे कौन्तेय, स्वभावज आफ्नै कर्मले निबद्ध; मोहले गर्न नचाहेको पनि अवश भएर गर्नेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Bound by your own action born of own-nature, O son of Kunti, what you do not wish to do from delusion you will do even helplessly.

shlokas.sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति। भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया॥
shlokas.transliteration: īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe'rjuna tiṣṭhati| bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे अर्जुन, सबै भूतको ईश्वर हृदयदेशमा स्थित; मायाले यन्त्रारूढ सबै भूत भ्रामण गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Lord stands in the heart-region of all beings, Arjuna, causing all beings to revolve by maya, as if mounted on a machine.

shlokas.sanskrit: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत। तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata| tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे भारत, सर्वभावले त्यही शरण जाओ; तत्प्रसादले परा शान्ति र शाश्वत स्थान पाउनेछौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Go to him alone for refuge with your whole being, O Bharata. By his grace you will attain the highest peace, the everlasting place.

shlokas.sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया। विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
shlokas.transliteration: iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ mayā| vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यसरी गुह्यभन्दा गुह्यतर ज्ञान मैले तिमीलाई आख्यात गरें; यो अशेष विमर्श गरी जस्तो इच्छा त्यस्तै गर।
shlokas.meaning_en: Thus knowledge more secret than secret has been declared by me to you. Having reflected on this without remainder, act as you wish.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः। इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ| iṣṭo'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सर्वगुह्यतम फेरि मेरो परम वचन सुन; तिमी मलाई दृढ इष्ट हौ, त्यसैले हित भन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Hear again my highest word, the most secret of all. You are firmly dear to me; therefore I shall speak what is for your good.

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे॥
shlokas.transliteration: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru| māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me||
shlokas.meaning_ne: मन्मना होओ, मद्भक्त, मद्याजी, मलाई नमस्कार गर; मकहाँ नै आउनेछौ — सत्य प्रतिज्ञा गर्छु, तिमी मलाई प्रिय हौ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Be one whose mind is on me, my devotee, my sacrificer; bow to me. You will come to me; I promise you truly, for you are dear to me.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज। अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
shlokas.transliteration: sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja| ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सबै धर्म परित्यज्य म एकमा शरण जाओ; म तिमीलाई सबै पापबाट मोक्ष गर्नेछु, नशोक गर।
shlokas.meaning_en: Abandoning all dharmas, go for refuge to me alone. I shall release you from all evils; do not grieve.

shlokas.sanskrit: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन। न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति॥
shlokas.transliteration: idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana| na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यो अतपस्कलाई, अभक्तलाई कहिल्यै नभन्नू; अशुश्रूषुलाई होइन, मलाई अभ्यसूया गर्नेलाई होइन।
shlokas.meaning_en: This is not to be told by you to one without tapas, nor to one without bhakti, nor to one who does not wish to hear, nor to one who finds fault with me.

shlokas.sanskrit: य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति। भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः॥
shlokas.transliteration: ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati| bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: यो परम गुह्य मद्भक्तहरूमा अभिधान गर्ने परा भक्ति ममा गरी सन्देहरहित मकहाँ आउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who will declare this highest secret among my devotees, having made the highest bhakti to me, will come to me without doubt.

shlokas.sanskrit: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः। भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि॥
shlokas.transliteration: na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ| bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi||
shlokas.meaning_ne: मनुष्यहरूमा त्यसभन्दा मलाई प्रियकृत्तम कोही छैन; भुवि त्यसभन्दा प्रियतर अरू हुनेछैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: Nor is there among men anyone who does more dear work for me than he; nor will there be another dearer than he on earth.

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः। ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः॥
shlokas.transliteration: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ| jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हाम्रो यो धर्म्य संवाद अध्ययन गर्ने ज्ञानयज्ञले मैले इष्ट हुनेछु — यो मेरो मति।
shlokas.meaning_en: And who will study this dialogue of ours, in accord with dharma — by him I shall be worshipped with the yajna of knowledge. That is my view.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः। सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ| so'pi muktaḥ śubhām̐llokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām||
shlokas.meaning_ne: श्रद्धावान् अनसूयु नर सुने पनि मुक्त भई पुण्यकर्मीहरूका शुभ लोक पाउँछ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The man full of faith, without finding fault, who would even hear it, he too, released, would reach the fair worlds of those of good works.

shlokas.sanskrit: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा। कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय॥
shlokas.transliteration: kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā| kaccidajñānasammohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे पार्थ, के यो एकाग्र चित्तले सुनियो? हे धनञ्जय, के तिम्रो अज्ञानसम्मोह प्रणष्ट भयो?
shlokas.meaning_en: Has this been heard by you, O Partha, with a one-pointed mind? Has the delusion of ignorance been destroyed for you, O Dhananjaya?

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत। स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
shlokas.transliteration: arjuna uvāca| naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta| sthito'smi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava||
shlokas.meaning_ne: अर्जुनले भने: हे अच्युत, तिम्रो प्रसादले मोह नष्ट, स्मृति लब्ध; स्थित छु, सन्देह गएको, तिम्रो वचन गर्नेछु।
shlokas.meaning_en: Arjuna said: Delusion is destroyed, memory is gained by me through your grace, O Acyuta. I stand with doubt gone; I shall do your word.

shlokas.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच। इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः। संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: sañjaya uvāca| ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ| saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सञ्जयले भने: वासुदेव र महात्मा पार्थको यो अद्भुत रोमहर्षण संवाद मैले यसरी सुनें।
shlokas.meaning_en: Sanjaya said: Thus I have heard this wondrous dialogue of Vasudeva and of the great-souled Partha, making the hair stand.

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्। योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param| yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam||
shlokas.meaning_ne: व्यासप्रसादले यो पर गुह्य सुनें — योगेश्वर कृष्णबाट स्वयं साक्षात् कथन् गर्दै योग।
shlokas.meaning_en: By Vyasa's grace I have heard this highest secret, yoga from Krishna the lord of yoga, himself speaking it in presence.

shlokas.sanskrit: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्। केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
shlokas.transliteration: rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam| keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे राजन्, केशव-अर्जुनको यो अद्भुत पुण्य संवाद संस्मरण-संस्मरण गर्दै मुहुर्मुहु हर्षित हुन्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: O king, remembering again and again this wondrous, holy dialogue of Keshava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

shlokas.sanskrit: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः। विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः॥
shlokas.transliteration: tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ| vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हरेको त्यो अत्यद्भुत रूप पनि संस्मरण-संस्मरण गर्दै, हे राजन्, महान् विस्मय हुन्छ, फेरि फेरि हर्षित।
shlokas.meaning_en: And remembering again and again that most wondrous form of Hari, great wonder is mine, O king, and I rejoice again and again.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
shlokas.transliteration: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ| tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जहाँ योगेश्वर कृष्ण, जहाँ धनुर्धर पार्थ — त्यहाँ श्री, विजय, भूति, ध्रुवा नीति छ भन्ने मेरो मति।
shlokas.meaning_en: Where Krishna is, lord of yoga, where Partha is, bearer of the bow — there is shri, victory, well-being, and lasting right, so I hold.

shlokas.sanskrit: ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे मोक्षसंन्यासयोगो नाम अष्टादशोऽध्यायः॥ १८॥
shlokas.transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde mokṣasaṃnyāsayogo nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||
shlokas.meaning_ne: ॐ तत् सत्। यस प्रकार श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता रूपी उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मविद्या र योगशास्त्रअन्तर्गत श्रीकृष्ण–अर्जुन संवादमा मोक्षसंन्यासयोग नामक १८ अध्याय समाप्त भयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Om tat sat. Thus ends chapter 18, named Moksha Sannyasa Yoga, in the Upanishad of the Bhagavad Gita, the knowledge of Brahman, the scripture of yoga, in the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.

shlokas.sanskrit: ॐ शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशम्। विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम्। लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यम्। वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम्॥
shlokas.transliteration: oṃ śāntākāraṃ bhujagaśayanaṃ padmanābhaṃ sureśam| viśvādhāraṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ meghavarṇaṃ śubhāṅgam| lakṣmīkāntaṃ kamalanayanaṃ yogibhirdhyānagamyam| vande viṣṇuṃ bhavabhayaharaṃ sarvalokaikanātham||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शान्त आकार भएका, शेषनागमा शयन गर्ने, कमलनाभ, देवताका ईश्वर, विश्वका आधार, आकाशजस्तै व्यापक, मेघवर्ण, शुभ अङ्ग भएका, लक्ष्मीका कान्त, कमलनयन, योगीहरूको ध्यानले प्राप्त हुने, भवभय हरण गर्ने, सबै लोकका एकमात्र नाथ विष्णुलाई म वन्दना गर्छु।
shlokas.meaning_en: I bow to Vishnu — of peaceful form, reclining on the serpent, lotus-naveled, lord of the gods, support of the world, vast as the sky, cloud-hued, of auspicious limbs, beloved of Lakshmi, lotus-eyed, reachable through the yogis' meditation, destroyer of the fear of worldly existence, the one lord of all worlds.
